newsitem.title: USA: ShoLodge files $125 mln shelf registration.
newsitem.headline: ShoLodge files $125 mln shelf registration.

text.p: ShoLodge Inc said on Friday it has filed a shelf registration with the securities and exchange commission covering $125 million of senior subordinated notes.

ShoLodge plans to offer these notes in various series from time to time to fund the ongoing development and renovation of inns and hotels, construction of the company's headquarters and for other general corporate purposes.
The registration statement filed specifies the first series of these notes to be a $35,000,000 offering of senior subordinated notes due 2006, the company said.
J.C. Bradford & Co, Dain Bosworth Inc, and Interstate Johnson Lane Corp are managing the proposed offering, ShoLodge said.
